decision_rule: Only requirements marked proved with current authoritative evidence may be claimed complete. partial, gap, blocked, or unverified keeps the thread goal active.

audit_items.requirement: Report Studio must keep the original Red Team analysis and add an independent Korean beginner-facing RedTeam AX v2 workbench as 레드팀 분석2.
audit_items.proof_summary: Tab registry exposes 레드팀 분석 and 레드팀 분석2; browser smoke checks reportStudio, redteamAnalysis, redteamAnalysis2, Korean body text, and RedTeam AX v2 markers.
audit_items.next_action: Continue UI coverage only when new panels are added.

audit_items.requirement: Frontend user-facing RedTeam AX content must be Korean and understandable to non-expert operators.
audit_items.proof_summary: Recent slices localize ToolActionCard, scanner guidance, runner, sanitizer, visual evidence, file upload, RBAC, role/severity/status displays and smoke validates koreanDisplayMapping.
audit_items.residual_gap: A full static Korean/no-English UX audit over every RedTeam2 visible label has not been automated yet.
audit_items.next_action: Add UI copy inventory check for RedTeam2 visible strings and permitted technical terms.

audit_items.requirement: Cases must operate through ROE, HITL, guardrails, and ToolActionCard before any tool/script/MCP/LLM-agent action.
audit_items.proof_summary: API tests cover health policy, ROE deny, high-risk ToolAction HITL, approval queue, actor-bound approval, T4/T5 controls, and manual-run invalid without ToolActionCard.
audit_items.next_action: Keep regression cases mandatory for future execution changes.

audit_items.requirement: Only approved tools, scripts, MCP, and LLM agents may be used; direct MCP/tool invocation must be denied by default.
audit_items.proof_summary: v2 API enforces ToolAction and approval controls for exposed routes; MCP gateway spec exists.
audit_items.residual_gap: An end-to-end MCP direct invocation denial smoke tied to the live gateway is not part of the current v2 browser/API regression set.
audit_items.next_action: Add explicit MCP direct invoke deny test or gateway smoke before claiming full completion.

audit_items.requirement: Nuclei, OpenVAS, Trivy, SCA, npm audit, and OWASP ZAP must be registered, selectable, safety-classified, and routed to LLM analysis agents.
audit_items.proof_summary: API registry exposes all six tools and six analysis agents; tests validate required tool names, agent IDs, trust policy, normalizers, and frontend ToolHub selection.
audit_items.next_action: Tie future tool additions to the registry/agent contract test.

audit_items.requirement: Tool installation integration and version-command evidence must be available for the scanner toolchain.
audit_items.proof_summary: Install-readiness registry returns operator-run install plans and safe version evidence placeholders without executing commands by API.
audit_items.residual_gap: FINAL_PLAN still lists actual CLI/container installation automation and version command evidence collection as incomplete.
audit_items.next_action: Implement operator-safe install evidence capture workflow and per-tool version proof artifacts.

audit_items.requirement: Every material artifact, image, log, tool result, and analysis judgment must flow into Evidence Card and Claim-Evidence Matrix tracking.
audit_items.proof_summary: Sample E2E covers manual artifacts, raw imports, normalization, Evidence Card creation/approval, Finding link, report validation, and Claim-Evidence Matrix report section.
audit_items.next_action: Add new artifact types to the same evidence path instead of bypassing it.

audit_items.requirement: High-risk execution must be human approved, human performed or reviewed, and AI must remain planner/evidence/analyzer/report-draft assistant.
audit_items.proof_summary: Tests and live smoke preserve commands_executed_by_api=false for unsafe flows, require approvals and uploaded artifacts, and block runner paths before required gates.
audit_items.next_action: Maintain no-runner invariant in live smoke when adding new browser actions.

audit_items.requirement: Korean Red Team Report v2 must combine Volkis-style Campaign Walkthrough with malware-report-style document control and evidence forms.
audit_items.proof_summary: Sample E2E generated report contains 문서 통제, Campaign Walkthrough, Claim-Evidence Matrix, zero gate counts, export approval block, executive approval, and exported artifact.
audit_items.next_action: Add visual regression for report preview only if report rendering UI changes.

audit_items.requirement: Agentic RAG canonical requirements must support SCA sufficient context, corpus routing, citation verifier, and unsupported claim hold.
audit_items.proof_summary: API tests cover approved-evidence SCA sufficiency, retrieve-again when claims lack approved evidence, report metadata persistence, and hold audit for unsupported claims.
audit_items.next_action: Keep Agentic RAG SPEC as canonical for future RAG changes.

audit_items.requirement: Red Team Studio folder, previous work index, and ChatShare transcript must be LLM-wiki indexed and callable.
audit_items.proof_summary: LLM wiki home links local manifest, top-dir/extension summaries, previous work index, and complete public ChatShare extraction package.
audit_items.next_action: Add qmd/kdq or graph index integration if downstream tooling requires it.

audit_items.requirement: All tests, security gates, sample case E2E, report verification, and regression checks must pass before final completion.
audit_items.proof_summary: Current narrow regression suite has passed in recent slices: plan contract, build, v2 API, sample E2E, and live smoke.
audit_items.residual_gap: The objective asks for full tests/security gate/regression; a full suite manifest and all-suite run artifact are not yet present.
audit_items.next_action: Create final verification harness that enumerates and runs the accepted full gate set.

audit_items.requirement: Final gate must prove unsupported claim, unapproved high-risk execution, and evidence-less Finding counts are all zero.
audit_items.proof_summary: Report validation tests block non-zero counts and sample E2E verifies zero unsupported_claim, unapproved_high_risk, finding_without_evidence, unapproved evidence/finding/severity before export.
audit_items.next_action: Use this gate as final objective audit input, not as sole proof of unrelated install/runtime requirements.

audit_items.requirement: OpenVAS and ZAP API credential vault and read-only token policy must exist for scanner integration.
audit_items.proof_summary: The requirement is explicitly tracked as incomplete in FINAL_PLAN.
audit_items.residual_gap: No credential vault contract/API/UI smoke has been verified for OpenVAS/ZAP.
audit_items.next_action: Design and implement credential vault contract with safe placeholder/read-only policy tests.

audit_items.requirement: Actual CLI/container runtime smoke must prove governed runtime readiness where applicable.
audit_items.proof_summary: Container runtime harness exists and records blocker evidence, but the runtime environment has not provided a successful real container execution proof.
audit_items.residual_gap: Docker/container daemon availability remains an environmental blocker for real runtime proof.
audit_items.next_action: When Docker is available, rerun real container runtime smoke and attach artifact.

audit_items.requirement: Completion audit itself must remain machine-checkable and prevent accidental goal-complete claims while gaps remain.
audit_items.proof_summary: The matrix declares goal_status active_incomplete, contains proved and unresolved statuses, and is validated by a sanity test.
audit_items.next_action: Update this matrix after each future slice until unresolved statuses reach zero with authoritative evidence.

remaining_gaps: Automated full UX copy audit for non-expert Korean RedTeam2 labels.
Live MCP direct invocation denial smoke.
Actual CLI/container installation automation and version command evidence collection.
OpenVAS/ZAP credential vault and read-only token policy.
Full accepted gate manifest and all-suite run artifact.
Successful real container runtime smoke after environment readiness.
next_slice_candidates: Add RedTeam2 Korean copy inventory checker.
Add MCP direct invoke deny regression.
Implement scanner install evidence capture workflow.
Create final verification harness for all accepted gates.
